$comment: Compass migration resolution config — OWNER-TUNABLE (mirrors scripts/audit-rubric.json pattern; edit values, no code/skill change needed). Starting defaults are the PROPOSED values Nikhil accepted as tunable defaults (STATE.md decision log, 2026-07-07). The 'guardrails' block is NOT tunable — it encodes standing owner rulings; changing it requires a new owner ruling, not an edit.

signalWeights.$comment: Relative trust per role-detection signal; must sum to 1.0.

caps.$comment: Hard ceilings applied after scoring. unresolvedConfusedWith: evidence cannot resolve a documented aiHints.confusedWith ambiguity. lightweightMeta: top candidate's meta is types-only (specStatus 'none' / empty selectionCriteria) so there is no spec-backed confirmation — best case is provisional, never auto-map.

thresholds.$comment: map: >= this = mapped (still reported with evidence). provisional: >= this and < map = MAY be pre-written as -compass variant but batch approval blocks until owner confirms each. below provisional = FLAGGED to _needs-decision.md, unit not migrated. gapList: no candidate reaches this = _gap-list.md entry (S6 candidate).

tokenRemap.$comment: snapPolicy 'same-tier-only': values may snap to the nearest scale step only within the same token tier (generate-code skill precedent). Owner may tighten to 'none' (every snap becomes a needs-decision item).

guardrails.$comment: NOT TUNABLE — standing owner rulings (STATE.md decision log 2026-07-07). Encoded here so engine output can cite them; the authoritative text lives in SKILL.md and resolution.md.
